note: Every company in this file is fictional. `about` is written as a search snippet would read. This fixture has no vertical on purpose: the buyer is defined by a need.

profile.value_proposition: First proper websites for small businesses and startups: live in four weeks, built to be found locally, with someone to ring afterwards.

pages./: Tidewater Digital. Websites for small businesses that have outgrown a Facebook page. A Bristol web design and marketing agency. Free website review.
pages./services: If you are newly trading, have no website, or have one that looks ten years old and brings in no enquiries, we build you a fast, modern site and get it found on Google. Website design, local SEO and Google Ads management. We work with owners directly.
pages./work: Recent launches: Redcliffe Physio, Bramble & Rye Catering, Totterdown Roofing. We work with startups and small firms of any trade: tradespeople, clinics, caterers, consultants, shops.
pages./pricing: Website design from £1,800. Local SEO and Google Ads from £350 a month. Most sites cost between £1,800 and £9,000. We are too small for enterprise tenders and we do not build for other agencies.

ground_truth: Small UK businesses and startups of any trade, about 1-25 staff, in Bristol and the South West first, that are newly incorporated or growing and have no website, a dated website, or a poor local search presence, and where the owner makes the decision. The trade does not matter; the need does. Not web designers, marketing or SEO agencies, freelancers or website-builder platforms; not established companies with an in-house marketing team; not large enterprises.
